verdict: An access-denied error was observed. The MECM client or the machine account lacks the permission for the operation.
fix: Identify the resource from the log line: `file`, `registry`, `WMI namespace`, or `share`. For content: confirm the machine account has `Read` on the content source path and the DP is healthy. For WMI: `Get-CimInstance -Namespace root\ccm -ClassName __Namespace` should succeed as SYSTEM; if not, repair the CCM WMI namespace via `ccmsetup.exe /forceinstall`. For domain-join drift (machine account invalid), re-join the client.
